Developing our People – Our people are the basis of our competitive advantage. We look to “grow our own” and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking, talented people choose to build their careers.

Responsabilidades:
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento, operação e evolução do SOC da Ekballo IT, com foco em ambientes críticos do setor elétrico;
  • Desenvolver, testar e operar playbooks de automação (SOAR) e processos robustos de Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) , alinhados aos padrões técnicos e regulatórios;
  • Assegurar a aderência total aos requisitos estabelecidos pelo ONS, ANEEL e às boas práticas aplicáveis ao segmento de transmissão de energia e subestações ;
  • Produzir documentação técnica rastreável, auditável e aderente aos processos regulatórios e operacionais;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de mobilização técnica , respeitando os cronogramas acordados com o cliente, garantindo a entrega de todos os artefatos técnicos exigidos.
Atividades Técnicas: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI):
  • Coletar, processar e enriquecer informações de ameaças (OSINT, FortiGuard, ISACs e outros feeds);
  • Correlacionar IOCs com eventos detectados no FortiSIEM, FortiEDR e ferramentas do ecossistema Fortinet;
  • Mapear TTPs com base nos frameworks MITRE ATT&CK, Diamond Model e Kill Chain ;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos que suportem análises de riscos cibernéticos voltadas ao setor elétrico;
  • Alimentar o FortiSOAR com dados estruturados (STIX, TAXII, CSV, JSON) para automação de respostas;
  • Atuar em threat hunting , priorizando riscos e ameaças relacionadas a ambientes OT e sistemas críticos.

  • A equipe alocada será composta por profissionais com experiência comprovada no setor elétrico , especialmente em projetos de transmissão de energia e subestações ;

  • Domínio das ferramentas Fortinet: FortiSOAR, FortiSIEM, FortiEDR, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate, FortiMail, FortiWeb ;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Threat Intelligence, IOC Enrichment, STIX/TAXII, MITRE ATT&CK, YARA ;

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table‑top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to support delivery and execution across our Sales Enablement and Frontline experience teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to initiatives that span multiple tools and workflows used by our sales and customer‑facing teams. You'll work closely with senior PMs, designers, engineers, and go‑to‑market partners to help scope, prioritize, and deliver features that improve productivity, consistency, and experience across our frontline ecosystem.

This is a great opportunity for a PM who thrives in cross‑functional, collaborative environments , and who enjoys solving practical product problems that make a real difference for internal users.

What you’ll do:

  • Contribute to the delivery of product initiatives across multiple Sales Enablement tools and workflows

  • Write clear product specs, coordinate timelines, and track progress toward milestones
  • Participate in team rituals and help maintain high delivery standards across squads
  • Communicate updates and risks to relevant stakeholders with clarity and structure

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in any area
  • Experience as a product manager working in cross‑functional software teams
  • Strong collaboration skills and a willingness to support shared goals across multiple teams
  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear steps with defined requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and ownership of day‑to‑day execution
  • Comfort working on internal‑facing tools and balancing user needs with technical constraints
  • A learning mindset and willingness to grow under the guidance of senior product leaders
  • Advanced communication and presentation skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on internal tools or platforms, especially for sales or frontline teams
  • Familiarity with sales enablement platforms, CRMs, or customer success tooling
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to product delivery processes (e.g. agile, sprint planning, release coordination)

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

Internally:

Externally:

  • with subcontractors
  • with carriers

  • with customs

Effectiveness Criteria

  • Service level (responsiveness)
  • Customer satisfaction - no FAQs

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Logistics Specialist to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

Para isso, combinamos uma atuação consultiva profunda a um processo de análise rigoroso, baseado em alto nível técnico e na construção de informações confiáveis, tanto para a empresa quanto para o investidor.

Acompanhamos poucas empresas por vez, com métricas claras, governança aplicada e alinhamento de interesses, participando ativamente da geração de valor ao longo da jornada.

Na Organismo, buscamos pessoas que queiram construir, executar e evoluir junto. Os projetos são complexos, o ritmo é intenso e o ambiente está em constante construção. Valorizamos profissionais que se sintam confortáveis em contextos dinâmicos, que gostem de desafios reais e tenham interesse genuíno em entender empresas por dentro e ajudá-las a evoluir.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar conosco como Representante de Serviços em Campo II e fazer parte de nossa equipe.

A Ecolab acredita na inclusão e na promoção da diversidade em todas as suas formas. Temos como valor e premissa, o respeito e valorização das pessoas e combatemos qualquer tipo de discriminação.   • Realizar o controle de dosagem química nos produtos utilizados nas instalações dos clientes para assegurar que estejam dentro das variações estabelecidas;
  • Coletar amostras e realizar as análises físico-químicas reportando os resultados ao laboratório central e ao cliente;
  • Controlar estoque de produtos nas instalações do cliente para um fornecimento dentro do prazo acordado;

  • Profissionais com conhecimento em tratamento de águas de industriais em gerais;
  • Possui CNH B (para dirigir carro da empresa) com no mínimo 2 anos de emissão e que esteja ATIVA. (não podendo encontrar-se suspensa, recolhida ou qualquer outra condição que impossibilidade o Funcionário de utilizar veículo)

  • Flexibilidade de horário para viagens e para possíveis demandas pontuais;

O que fará seu perfil se destacar dos demais?

  • Ter experiência profissional em indústria de tratamento de águas;
  • Experiência no setor de químicos;
  • Conhecimentos em Pacote Office (Excel, Power Point e Outlook) e sistemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento.

O que te oferecemos nessa jornada?

Salário competitivo, Auxílio Refeição, Carro Ferramenta, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, PLR, Programa de Treinamentos Internos, Programa de Desenvolvimento e Trilha de Carreira, entre outros

Um parceiro de confiança para quase três milhões de clientes, a Ecolab é líder global em sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções e serviços para água, higiene e prevenção de infecções, que protegem as pessoas e os recursos vitais. Com mais de um século de inovação, a Ecolab apresenta vendas anuais de US$ 14 bilhões e 47.000 funcionários, operando em mais de 170 países em todo o mundo. A empresa oferece soluções abrangentes, baseadas na ciência, conhecimentos específicos e serviços de classe mundial para promover a segurança dos alimentos, manter os ambientes limpos e seguros e otimizar o uso da água e energia. As soluções inovadoras da Ecolab melhoram a eficiência operacional e a sustentabilidade de clientes nos setores de alimentos, industrial, saúde e hospitalidade.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

  • Assessoria de Investimentos

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

O(a) profissional será responsável por apoiar na elaboração, revisão e acompanhamento de documentos societários e contratuais, bem como no suporte jurídico às operações e projetos estratégicos da companhia.

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Mercado/ BI PL para atuar no monitoramento e análise do mercado de couro bovino. A posição integra a área de Business Intelligence da companhia que é responsável pelas demandas de inteligência de mercado e, portanto, pela geração de análises e insights que orientam as decisões comerciais e estratégicas dos negócios.

  • Acompanhar preços, fluxos de exportação e importação, volumes e players do mercado, bem como dos mercados que utilizam couro bovino como matéria-prima;

  • Monitorar indicadores econômicos e geopolíticos que impactam o negócio;
  • Pesquisar, tratar, estruturar e analisar bases de dados, tanto internos quanto de fontes externas (tais como consultorias de dados, sites oficiais dos países, associações representativas de setores etc.), utilizando Excel, Power BI, SQL e Python;

  • Conduzir as reuniões semanais com o time comercial para discussão sobre mercado, preços, volume e posicionamento de mercado;

Formação em Administração, Economia, Comércio Exterior, Engenharia(s) ou áreas correlatas.

title: Product Manager Campinas, Brazil
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision‑making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium‑to‑large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

Demographic Brazil

ABInBev is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce and culture. We conduct confidential surveys to better understand & ensure we provide equal opportunity throughout our end-to-end recruitment process. Individuals seeking employment at ABInBev are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

When you apply to a job on this site, the personal information contained in your application will be collected by ABINBEV SERVICES LLC. Qual a missão do Cargo?

Garantir a qualidade técnica e funcional das entregas do produto, atuando de forma colaborativa com o time de desenvolvimento para promover práticas de automação, prevenção de defeitos e melhoria contínua. O desafio principal é garantir entregas seguras, estáveis e com alto padrão de qualidade, contribuindo para a maturidade dos processos de teste e observabilidade.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Atuar no planejamento, execução e automação de testes funcionais, regressivos e exploratórios.
  • Validar integrações entre APIs e microsserviços, garantindo cobertura e rastreabilidade dos testes.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação (backend) integrados ao pipeline CI/CD.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na identificação e prevenção de defeitos desde as etapas iniciais.
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e discussões técnicas voltadas à qualidade e desempenho.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz para falhas recorrentes e propor soluções de melhoria.
  • Apoiar a evolução de métricas de qualidade e observabilidade (defeitos, cobertura, tempo de execução).

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência em automação de testes de API (Postman, RestAssured ou similares).
  • Experiência em automação de testes utilizando as linguagens Python, Java ou Javascript.
  • Experiência em elaboração e execução de Testes Funcionais, Testes Não-Funcionais (testes de performance e usabilidade).
  • Níveis de teste: Testes Unitários, Testes Integração/Serviço, Testes de Sistema.
  • Técnicas de teste: Caixa branca, Caixa preta, Exploratórios.
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes web (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou equivalentes). Vivência com pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Bitbucket).
  • Experiência em análise de logs, troubleshooting e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Domínio em versionamento (Git) e boas práticas de testes em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados SQL e NoSQL para validação de dados.
  • Capacidade de escrever cenários de teste com clareza e alinhamento aos critérios de aceite.

Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência com produtos regulatórios.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Experiência em testes de performance (JMeter, k6) e segurança (OWASP).
  • Contribuições em comunidades técnicas, QA Guilds ou projetos open source.
  • Atuação prévia com frameworks de BDD (Cucumber, Behave).
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas kubernetes, docker.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

title: Product Manager - Personalization
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user-centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision-making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Senior Global Recruiter
description:
Overview

About Nu
Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company leads an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

People and Culture at Nubank

Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank’s culture. We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders. You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values. We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive full-cycle recruitment
  • Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.
  • Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.
  • Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.
  • Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.

You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.
  • A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.
  • Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).
  • Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.
  • Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Nice To Have

  • Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.

Benefits

  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program
  • Gympass partnership
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Espaço Feijão - Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. We hire based on equality and consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting talented individuals.

Descrição da Vaga

O/A Analista de Precificação e Custos

Será essencial no apoio à formação e atualização de preços dos serviços prestados, estruturando modelos de pricing, elaborando rate cards e realizando simulações de impactos (dissídio, benefícios, encargos e mudanças de escala).

Este profissional será responsável por mapear e controlar custos diretos e indiretos, acompanhar drivers de rentabilidade, apoiar análises de margem por contrato e garantir rastreabilidade das premissas utilizadas. Atuará também na padronização de processos, automatização de rotinas e na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais que suportem decisões estratégicas do negócio.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Apoiar na formação, atualização e controle de preços de serviços (postos/hora/escala/região/cliente);
  • Estruturar e manter modelos de precificação (custo + markup / preço-alvo / cenários);
  • Elaborar e atualizar rate cards (tabelas de preço) por tipo de serviço e unidade;
  • Simular impactos de reajustes salariais/dissídio, benefícios, encargos, inflação e mudanças de escala/turnos;
  • Garantir trilha de evidências e versionamento das premissas utilizadas nas propostas;
  • Mapear e atualizar custos diretos (mão de obra, benefícios, adicionais, horas extras, coberturas, insumos) e custos indiretos/overhead (supervisão, estrutura, G&A);
  • Definir e acompanhar drivers de custo: custo/hora, custo/posto, custo por escala, absenteísmo, turnover, cobertura, deslocamento;
  • Apoiar análises de rentabilidade e margem por contrato/cliente/serviço, indicando desvios e oportunidades de correção;
  • Atualizar e acompanhar indicadores de margem bruta e margem de contribuição por contrato;
  • Apoiar a construção e atualização de relatórios gerenciais (mensal/semanal): margem, custos, variações e desempenho por contrato;
  • Apoiar o fechamento mensal com conciliações e validações relacionadas a custos e rentabilidade (quando aplicável);
  • Suportar auditorias internas/externas com organização de evidências e rastreabilidade das premissas e bases utilizadas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência prévia com precificação, custos, controladoria ou FP&A (preferencialmente em serviços);
  • Excel/Sheets avançado (PROCV/XLOOKUP, SOMASES, ÍNDICE/CORRESP, Tabela Dinâmica, cenários);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de interface com Comercial e Operações;
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes (rastreabilidade e premissas).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ERP (TOTVS/SAP/Oracle/NetSuite ou similares);
  • Power BI / Looker Studio e Power Query;
  • Experiência com RFPs/propostas e governança de pricing;
  • Conhecimento de custos de mão de obra (encargos/benefícios/adicionais/escala).

  • Permanecer atualizado sobre as tendências do setor, regulamentações financeiras e melhores práticas de planejamento financeiro, buscando constantemente maneiras de aprimorar os processos e procedimentos existentes.

Banco

A Casa Hacker é uma organização da sociedade civil de educação STEAM e inovação social. Nossa Teoria da Mudança coloca todo nosso time e parceiros técnicos, conhecimento e nossa rede para inovar, criando e co-criando iniciativas de educação STEAM e inovação social para tornar as tecnologias digitais e a Internet acessíveis para todos e fazer com que todos os cidadãos sejam capazes de transformar seus territórios, considerando este contexto, a Casa Hacker investe em programas de inovação nos territórios em que atua e busca profissionais com experiência comprovada para liderar a estratégia conosco.

No time de Educação STEAM da Casa Hacker, o Professor(a) é essencialmente pedagógico. O dia a dia envolve a condução de oficinas “mão na massa”, a mediação das descobertas em sala de aula e o registro observacional do progresso dos alunos. É um papel que exige didática e empatia para lidar com diferentes perfis e ritmos de aprendizado, indo desde a instrução técnica sobre o uso de kits até o acolhimento socioemocional dos participantes. Buscamos alguém que assegure um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e instigante, garantindo que os objetivos educacionais sejam atingidos a cada encontro. O programa de educação STEAM é formado por diretores, gerência de programas, coordenação pedagógica, assistentes, professores e especialistas temáticos.

Principais Responsabilidades e Desafios

  • Conduzir oficinas e aulas presenciais utilizando metodologias ativas e Aprendizagem Baseada em Projetos (ABP), garantindo o engajamento de turmas com até 20 participantes.
  • Atuar como mediador(a) nos processos de experimentação e investigação, incentivando a autonomia e o pensamento crítico.
  • Adaptar os planos de aula e abordagens pedagógicas às necessidades específicas e ritmos de cada grupo, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor e inclusivo.
  • Assegurar a segurança dos participantes e o uso correto (e zeloso) de equipamentos, kits educacionais e espaços de aprendizagem.
  • Avaliar o desenvolvimento dos participantes não apenas por entregas finais, mas pelo progresso na jornada de aprendizagem.
  • Registrar relatórios diários de aulas (diário de bordo), documentando observações, lições aprendidas e pontos de atenção.
  • Manter comunicação fluida com a coordenação, famílias e escolas parceiras sobre o desenvolvimento e frequência dos participantes.
  • Estabelecer uma relação de confiança e escuta ativa, fortalecendo o vínculo dos alunos com o espaço e o conhecimento.
  • Testar e validar kits educacionais e materiais didáticos em contexto real, fornecendo feedbacks técnicos à equipe para aprimoramento dos produtos.

description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Search product within the BEES app. Search is a critical capability for BEES, powering most product findability flows and directly impacting GMV across multiple markets.

This role sits within the BEES Core team, responsible for building scalable, reliable, and reusable capabilities that serve multiple BEES platforms (Customer, Force, and Link).

You will work closely with engineering, data, design, and multiple product teams to evolve our search algorithms, infrastructure, and user experience, ensuring high performance, reliability, and relevance at scale.

  • Leverage data to drive decisions, using existing dashboards and building new analyses when needed;
  • Drive the evolution of search capabilities, including relevance tuning, commercial indicators, and future AI and natural language search initiatives;
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, presenting updates and insights to senior leadership.

What you'll need:

  • University degree in a field related to the role;

  • Strong understanding of search systems, algorithms, or highly scalable backend services (hands-on experience is a plus, but not mandatory);
  • Ability to comfortably communicate with engineers, understanding both backend and frontend concepts and trade-offs;
  • Experience working with data to analyze product performance, identify issues, and support decision-making;
  • Experience working in cross-functional and highly collaborative environments;
  • Familiarity with Agile product development practices;
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken), with the ability to present and communicate with global stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience with search, ranking, personalization, or recommendation systems;
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (especially Azure);
  • Experience working on core or platform products that serve multiple applications or teams.

Sobre nós

Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente – Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor – Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada – Nossa cultura é forte. Só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Nosso time de Dados

São os times responsáveis por definir quando a contratação de um crédito será boa para o cliente e para o Agibank, buscando o sucesso e sustentabilidade de ambos no longo prazo. Apoiam ativamente a prevenção de fraudes, com estratégias inteligentes. O time de Dados, utilizando tecnologia e visão de futuro, sustenta decisões assertivas e eficientes.

Seus desafios para crescer na jornada

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning para resolver problemas complexos com impacto para o negócio.
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados para estudos analíticos.
  • Criar relatórios que traduzam resultados técnicos em insights para as áreas de negócio.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para formular hipóteses, entender as necessidades, avaliar a aplicação dos modelos nas estratégias, testar soluções e acompanhar resultados.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e governança dos dados utilizados nos projetos analíticos.

O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?

Requisitos

  • Experiência com linguagens de programação como Python ou R.
  • Domínio de algoritmos clássicos e modernos de aprendizado de máquina, como árvores de decisão, regressão logística, ensemble e boosting models (ex.: XGBoost, LightGBM, catboost).
  • Forte base em estatística, probabilidade e modelagem preditiva.
  • Vivência com manipulação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados (SQL, Spark).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de crédito (indicadores, estratégias, técnicas).
  • Experiência com modelos de risco de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps e deploy de modelos em produção.
  • Experiência ou interesse em projetos de IA generativa, NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) ou modelos de grandes linguagens (LLMs).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e integração contínua.

Benefícios e facilidades

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, vale-refeição e alimentação e seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral.

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.
  • Vale-transporte.
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito.
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário.
  • Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte.
  • Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI.

  • Crédito do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa.

Programa Tô de dono

O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. We are looking for Data Product Managers to join our Computer Vision team, playing a critical role at the intersection of business, data science, and engineering. You will own the strategy, execution, and adoption of AI‑powered computer vision products used across global markets.

This role requires strong product leadership, fluency in ML‑driven products, and the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into business value for commercial and customer stakeholders.

  • Continuously improve our testing practices, tools, and processes to increase efficiency and reliability.

  • 4+ years of experience as a Python engineer building production systems;

  • Early-stage startup experience;
  • Experience building with LLMs or agentic AI systems;
  • Leadership experience;

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.
